text: I called experian to report unauthorized inquiries and agent mentioned I should add fraud alert on my credit report. But agent did not mention it will show up on my credit report and I will be also removed from pre approved mailing offers etc. Now because of experian fraud alert there is a fraud alert and statement on my experian and other credit bureaus as experian also sent request to other credit agencies. I have contacted experian 3 times by submitting request in writing 3 times and also uploaded form that I don't want fraud alert on my credit reports and I want it to be removed immediately. One of the successful request to experian was submitted on XX/XX/2023. It seems fraud alert is being added again and again without my authorization. It seems experian computer systems are automatically adding fraud alert despite me requesting to remove from all bureaus. Kindly check your records as I have asked you multiple time by uploading form online and also uploading my identity card and utility bill to remove this alert for once and all. But you have removed and than added again. Kindly remove it immediately. I am tired of writing and submitting my documents again and again to you guys. Supporting documents attached below and confirmation of fraud alert from you guys is attached below as well.
